release: SAB Ownership Continuity & Managed Update Handoff
changes: Prevents temporary SAB queue-slot omissions from destroying NewzDeck job ownership while SAB continues transferring the package.
Uses aggregate SAB transfer telemetry to bridge the active foreground package when SAB temporarily omits its individual queue slot, preventing 0-active UI gaps during a real transfer.
Reserves removal tombstones for explicit user Remove/Cancel actions; automatic stale ownership cleanup no longer creates a tombstone that can suppress later completion history.

Keeps Smart Import/Automation jobs durably tracked across queue-to-history handoff gaps and can reconcile recent legacy reasonless automatic-prune tombstones without resurrecting genuine user removals.
Adds a native managed in-app update coordinator copied outside the install directory so it survives Setup replacement of NewzDeck files.
Managed updates close the actual NewzDeck Edge/Chrome app-mode window and tray, run and wait for Setup, then restore the installed background service, tray, and NewzDeck application.
Applies the same managed lifecycle to verified online Update Center installs and manually selected NewzDeck Setup packages.
regression_guards: Preserves v3.6.10 Python Source Freshness & Runtime Refresh.
Preserves v3.6.9 installer shutdown protection for the tray, background service, Picker, thumbnail workers, and native yEnc workers.
Preserves all accepted v3.6.8 image-browsing performance and gallery-quality improvements.
Explicit user Remove/Cancel tombstones remain terminal; only legacy reasonless automatic-prune tombstones can be reconciled.
The update coordinator runs from the version-independent update staging directory and therefore does not lock the installed NewzDeckPicker.exe during Setup.
name: SAB Ownership Continuity & Managed Update Handoff
